title: WITHDRAWN: ADOPT the staff recommendation for the following official and operational station names for the two stations that comprise Metro Rail’s D Line…
text:
[Metro Board file 2026-0621, Program]
[EXECUTIVE MANAGEMENT COMMITTEE FORWARDED THE FOLLOWING:]
WITHDRAWN: 

ADOPT the staff recommendation for the following official and operational station names for the two stations that comprise Metro Rail’s D Line Extension, Section 3:

Official Station Name: Wilshire/UCLA		
Operational Station Name: Wilshire/UCLA
			
Official Station Name: Wilshire/VA Medical Ctr		
Operational Station Name: Wilshire/VA Medical Ctr
summary: Withdrawn item proposing official and operational station names for two stations on Metro Rail's D Line Extension, Section 3: Wilshire/UCLA and Wilshire/VA Medical Center.

locations.text: Wilshire Boulevard & UCLA, Los Angeles, CA
Wilshire Boulevard & VA Medical Center, Los Angeles, CA
